scope.purpose: test whether the residual of the frozen causal GMP contains a low-cost conjugate-linear component
not_claimed: physical attribution to the PA rather than the feedback path

hypothesis.model: y_hat_wl[n] = y_hat_gmp[n] + sum_{d in D} b_d * conj(x[n-d])
hypothesis.regression_target: fit b so that sum_d b_d*conj(x[n-d]) approximates e[n]
hypothesis.interpretation: a reproducible gain is evidence for a widely-linear measurement-or-PA asymmetry; it is not by itself evidence that the physical PA is the source
hypothesis.phase_equivariance: intentionally relaxed only in the measured conjugate direction for this diagnostic
hypothesis.negative_lag_policy: negative residual-correlation lags are future-input diagnostics and are forbidden as deployable model features

discovery_evidence.usage_status: both train OOF and validation residual reports were inspected while choosing this family; neither is an independent confirmation set for this family

correction_fit.frame_state_policy: zero/reset delayed-input state at every explicit frame
correction_fit.oof_protocol: for each leave-one-explicit-frame-out fold, refit the frozen GMP recipe on fit frames, compute fit-frame residuals, fit conjugate coefficients only on those residuals, and predict the held frame
correction_fit.full_train_protocol: use the integrity-verified full-train frozen GMP, fit conjugate coefficients on full-train residuals, then report the already-viewed validation split descriptively
correction_fit.test_protocol: forbidden in this audit; a separate frozen release decision and preferably a new capture are required

operation_count_convention.conjugation: sign-bit or wiring operation; zero MUL and zero ADD
operation_count_convention.input_state: reuse the selected GMP raw complex delay buffer because all candidate delays are within 0..4

selection_rule.candidate_score: min(full_record_gain_db, common_interior_gain_db) relative to no_correction; larger is better
selection_rule.complexity_tie_break: among eligible candidates within 0.02 dB of the best candidate_score, choose the fewest conjugate taps
selection_rule.fallback: select no_correction if no conjugate support is eligible

required_metrics: post-fit proper and pseudo residual correlations
reporting.validation_label: already-viewed descriptive validation, never independent confirmation
reporting.test_metrics: must not be read or emitted

follow_up_gate.if_internal_audit_passes: prioritize feedback-path IQ/frequency-response calibration and obtain a new independent capture before attributing the effect to PA physics
follow_up_gate.if_internal_audit_fails: do not retain the conjugate branch; proceed to the next preregistered causal spline/CPWL plus short-FIR hypothesis
follow_up_gate.dpa_policy: do not tune a separate DPA conjugate support from already-viewed DPA residuals; any DPA transfer check must use the APA-frozen support and be labelled non-independent
